# anthropic_skill (Resource)

Uploads a custom skill from a local directory and keeps it current. The directory must contain a `SKILL.md` with `name` and `description` frontmatter; its basename becomes the skill's top-level directory. The provider hashes the files on every plan: when the content changes it uploads a new skill version and `latest_version_id` moves. Skills have no update endpoint and the API returns no content hash, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

`terraform destroy` deletes the skill and every version. Set `delete_on_destroy = false` to leave it in place. Deleting a version that an agent or deployment pins breaks them at run time.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The directory must contain SKILL.md; its basename becomes the skill folder.
resource "anthropic_skill" "release_notes" {
  source_dir = "${path.module}/skills/example-skill"
}

resource "anthropic_agent" "writer" {
  name  = "release-writer"
  model = "claude-sonnet-5"

  skills = [
    { type = "custom", skill_id = anthropic_skill.release_notes.id, version = anthropic_skill.release_notes.latest_version_id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_dir` (String) Local directory holding `SKILL.md` and up to 20 files (30 MB total). Changing the path forces a new skill.

### Optional

- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the skill (all versions) on destroy. Defaults to `true`.
- `display_name` (String) Display label, up to 255 characters. Defaults to the `SKILL.md` name. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) SHA-256 over the sorted file paths and contents of `source_dir`, computed locally on every plan.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Skill id (`skill_...`).
- `latest_version_id` (String) Id of the newest version; pin agents to it with `skills[].version`.
- `name` (String) Slug from the `SKILL.md` frontmatter; every version must keep it.
- `source_type` (String) Always `custom` for uploaded skills.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_skill.release_notes skill_01ExampleSkillId000000000
```
